fusions.name: Barbed Tine
fusions.desc: Hurls a barbed tine that deals 8 piercing damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Snagging Rake
fusions.desc: Your next weapon strike deals 12 piercing damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it then spread to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Haul In
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 4 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Barb by Barb
fusions.desc: Every critical hit you land sets a barb in that enemy, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all and strikes it for 34% of your weapon damage per barb (170% at full). Unfed, a barb fades every 4 seconds.
